# ISO8583Studio

> Free, open-source (AGPL v3) desktop workbench for payment engineers: nine
> simulators (five shipping, four in development) and 64 tools for ISO 8583 message testing, EMV certification
> preparation, Thales payShield 10K HSM simulation, PIN-block and key
> operations. Runs on Windows and macOS; builds from source on Linux. Keys and
> test data never leave your machine. Maintained by Sourabh Kaushik.

Simulate an authorization host, an HSM, a POS terminal, a card and a switch on
one laptop, then send a 0200 and script the 0210 response with no bank
connection, lab booking or physical HSM.

## Core concepts
- [ISO 8583 message format](https://iso8583.studio/blogs/understanding-iso8583-message-format): message structure, MTI, bitmaps and data elements
- [Message Type Indicators](https://iso8583.studio/blogs/iso8583-message-type-indicators): the 0200/0210 authorization pair and other MTIs
- [Bitmaps explained](https://iso8583.studio/blogs/iso8583-bitmap-explained): primary and secondary bitmaps and field presence
- [Field 39 response codes](https://iso8583.studio/blogs/iso8583-response-codes-reference): approval and decline codes
- [ISO 9564 PIN block formats](https://iso8583.studio/blogs/pin-block-formats-iso9564): layout, padding and AES Format 4
- [DUKPT key derivation](https://iso8583.studio/blogs/dukpt-key-derivation-guide): BDK, IPEK and transaction keys
- [TR-31 key blocks](https://iso8583.studio/blogs/tr31-key-block-guide): key block structure and interchange

## Simulators
- [Host Simulator](https://iso8583.studio/simulator/host): acquirer/issuer host in server, client or proxy mode over TCP/IP, REST, RS232 or dial-up
- [HSM Simulator](https://iso8583.studio/simulator/hsm): Thales payShield 10K host commands for key management, PIN translation and ISO 9797 MAC
- [HSM Command Console](https://iso8583.studio/simulator/hsm-command-console): interactive payShield host-command client with worked request/response pairs
- [POS Simulator](https://iso8583.studio/simulator/pos): terminal emulation across 23 device models, including APK install
- [APDU Simulator](https://iso8583.studio/simulator/apdu): card-level APDU dialogue and TLV for L3 test cases
- [All simulators](https://iso8583.studio/simulator): status, protocol and transport per simulator

## Tools
- [EMV & Card Tools](https://iso8583.studio/tools/emv-tools): SDA/DDA verification, ARQC/ARPC cryptograms, M/Chip, VSDC, CAP
- [PIN Tools](https://iso8583.studio/tools/pin-tools): PIN block build and translate, IBM 3624 offset, PVV, AS2805
- [Key Management Tools](https://iso8583.studio/tools/key-tools): DUKPT, TR-31, key components, KCVs, Thales key formats
- [MAC Tools](https://iso8583.studio/tools/mac-tools): ISO 9797-1, ANSI X9.9/X9.19, HMAC
- [Cryptographic Tools](https://iso8583.studio/tools/cipher-tools): 3DES, AES, RSA, hashing, format-preserving encryption (FF1, FF3-1)
- [DUKPT Tools](https://iso8583.studio/tools/dukpt-tools), [Card Validation](https://iso8583.studio/tools/card-validation), [Data Converters](https://iso8583.studio/tools/utility-tools)

## Project
- [Download](https://iso8583.studio/download): installers for Windows and macOS, build instructions for Linux
- [Installation guide](https://iso8583.studio/docs/installation): requirements and first run
- [Version history](https://iso8583.studio/docs/versions): every release with dates and changes
- [Source code](https://github.com/hpkaushik121/Iso8583studio): AGPL v3 repository and issue tracker

## Optional
- [EMV certification services](https://iso8583.studio/emv-certification): L1/L2/L3 and scheme certification consulting
- [Cloud simulators](https://iso8583.studio/cloud-simulators): hosted host and HSM endpoints, by enquiry
